field_notes.battle_card_skill: EXCLUDED — battle_card_skill contains battle-behavior effects only (trigger_type, cd_time, use_position, march_place = in-battle action system). No stat_id references. Does NOT contribute to Hero Power. skill_group_ids stored for reference only.
field_notes.power_field_meaning: battle_card.power = {1: power_at_max_level, 2: power_per_level}. For starred (Expertise) cards, authoritative power is battle_card_star.power per star. power_game_max = max(star_progression powers) or power_at_max_level if no stars.
field_notes.level_cost_items: item 14501=Profession EXP (Excess) (UR star cards), item 14502=Tactical Fragment (all others)
field_notes.star_cost_tier: battle_card_star.cost = upgrade tier integer (1=cheap, 3=expensive), server-computed actual cost
field_notes.attr_encoding: attr_base={stat_id:val_at_lv1}, attr_per_level={stat_id:increment}. Value at level N = base + increment*(N-1)
field_notes.random_attr: pool_id links to battle_card_random_attr. Detail per-stat ranges in battle_card_random_attr_detail (quality_min/max/step)
field_notes.skill_display_params: Raw parameter string(s) for skill description text formatting. Not IDs. Can be dict (one entry per star level) or string.
field_notes.power_mismatch_root_cause: Card 500501 (Purgator - Monster Slayer): base stat (76053) contributes 3543.75 power at lv10, but game power is 800000 because random_attr pool contributes ~796456 expected power. Random attr contribution is intentionally baked into power_game. NOT an extraction error.
excluded_tables: battle_card_box: gacha pack definitions (not card stats)
battle_card_box_pool: server-based pool rotation (not card stats)
battle_card_box_reward: milestones from gacha pulls (not card stats)
battle_card_change: old->new card ID migration (not card stats)
battle_card_report: battle report display config (no stats)
battle_card_reward: card collection milestones (not card stats)
battle_card_slot: slot unlock conditions by mastery (not card stats)
battle_card_random_attr_show: display-only quality name config (no additional stat data)
